args.cypher:
MATCH (aas:AssetAdministrationShell)-[:HAS_SUBMODEL]->(sm:Submodel)
      -[:HAS_ELEMENT*]->(el:SubmodelElement)
      WHERE toLower(el.idShort) CONTAINS 'transport' OR toLower(el.idShort) CONTAINS 'robot'
      RETURN DISTINCT aas.idShort AS aas_id, aas.id AS aas_uri, sm.idShort AS submodel_id, el.idShort AS element_id, el.category

      -[:HAS_ELEMENT*]->(e:Entity)-[:REPRESENTS_ASSET]->(asset:Asset)

       asset.globalAssetId AS asset_globalAssetId, asset.assetKind AS asset_assetKind,
       asset.assetType AS asset_assetType
